messages.text: Carragher: Boring Newcastle face a tough season ahead

metadata.summary: Jamie Carragher described Newcastle as flat and boring following their defeat to Everton on Monday Night Football and reckons Matthias Jaissle's side faces a difficult season.
metadata.content: 'Newcastle are flat and boring' – Jamie Carragher warns Magpies face tough Premier League season after Everton defeat | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Analysis 'Newcastle are flat and boring' – Jamie Carragher warns Magpies face tough Premier League season after Everton defeat Newcastle were booed off at home after losing 1-0 to Everton on Monday Night Football; Matthias Jaissle's side have lost three of their last four Premier League matches; Newcastle are 13th with three wins from nine games and head to Fulham, who are below them, on Saturday Jamie Carragher Football Expert and Columnist Tuesday 3 November 2026 00:04, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Jamie Carragher says recent Newcastle performances have been 'flat' and a 'little boring' believing they are in for a 'tough season.' Jamie Carragher described Newcastle as flat and boring following their defeat to Everton on Monday Night Football and reckons Matthias Jaissle's side faces a difficult season. Thierno Barry's second-half goal earned Everton a 1-0 win at St James' Park and their first away victory in the Premier League this season, as Newcastle were booed off at half-time and full-time following their fourth defeat in five games across all competitions. Newcastle have slipped to 13th and are now four points above the bottom three, with a trip to lowly Fulham to come on Saturday. Newcastle news & transfers ⚫⚪| Newcastle fixtures & scores Got Sky? messages.text: Russell posts statement to 'speak from the heart'

metadata.summary: George Russell has posted a statement on social media to "speak from the heart" after his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli secured the F1 Drivers' Championship on Sunday.
metadata.content: George Russell: Mercedes driver posts statement to 'speak from the heart' after Kimi Antonelli becomes world champion at Mexico City Grand Prix | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content George Russell: Mercedes driver posts statement to 'speak from the heart' after Kimi Antonelli becomes world champion at Mexico City Grand Prix Mercedes' George Russell took to social media on Monday after not speaking to the media after Sunday's Mexico City GP, where his team-mate Kimi Antonelli became world champion; watch Friday's practice sessions for the Sao Paulo GP at 3.30pm and 7pm, live on Sky Sports F1 Monday 2 November 2026 20:31, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Martin Brundle believes Kimi Antonelli winning the world title could trigger an 'overdrive' for George Russell, or it's 'game over' for the Mercedes team-mate George Russell has posted a statement on social media to "speak from the heart" after his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli secured the F1 Drivers' Championship on Sunday. Mercedes boss Toto Wolff revealed Russell was "distraught" in Mexico and went home after congratulating Antonelli on becoming world champion. The FIA gave Mercedes a €5,000 (£4,173) fine as Russell missed his mandatory media duties post-race, but the British driver has made his own first public comments on Monday. metadata.summary: Renowned defence coach Shaun Edwards says England boss Steve Borthwick turned down his offer to work with the side at the 2027 Rugby World Cup in Australia.
metadata.content: England rugby: Shaun Edwards says Steve Borthwick turned down his offer to work with side at 2027 World Cup | Rugby Union News | Sky Sports Skip to main content England rugby: Shaun Edwards says Steve Borthwick turned down his offer to work with side at 2027 World Cup Shaun Edwards told Steve Borthwick that he would be "assistant kit man" if required but England head coach happy with his current staff; Borthwick's side play Australia at Twickenham's Allianz Stadium on Sunday, before clashes with Japan and New Zealand across the next two weekends Monday 2 November 2026 20:21, UK Image: Shaun Edwards says England head coach Steve Borthwick turned down his offer to work with the side at the 2027 Rugby World Cup in Australia. Renowned defence coach Shaun Edwards says England boss Steve Borthwick turned down his offer to work with the side at the 2027 Rugby World Cup in Australia. Edwards ended a six-year spell with France - during which Les Bleus won three Six Nations, including back-to-back in 2025 and 2026 - earlier this year. The 60-year-old worked with the England women's team on a short-term basis and has now moved onto Argentina's staff until the end of next year's World Cup, which runs across October and November. metadata.summary: England's Vitality Roses will host South Africa in a three-Test netball series in February, with all matches live on Sky Sports.
metadata.content: England to host South Africa in three-Test netball series live on Sky Sports in February as World Cup preparation | Netball News | Sky Sports Skip to main content England to host South Africa in three-Test netball series live on Sky Sports in February as World Cup preparation Vitality Roses will tackle the Proteas twice in London and once in Leicester in February 2027; games will help sides prepare for Netball World Cup in Australia in August and September; England edged South Africa this summer to reach Commonwealth Games semi-finals at opponents' expense Monday 2 November 2026 18:00, UK Image: England will play South Africa in London and Leicester in February 2027 as they build for the Netball World Cup in Australia (image credit: Ben Lumley) England's Vitality Roses will host South Africa in a three-Test netball series in February, with all matches live on Sky Sports. The games will serve as preparation for the 2027 World Cup in Australia across late August and early September. England, currently third in the world rankings, will take on fifth-placed South Africa at Wembley Arena in London on February 6 and 7 before the series concludes at Leicester's Mattioli Arena on February 10.
